answer: Latency-ridge attestation routing. Each identity must accumulate a ridge of independent, time-stamped task receipts from distinct counterparties before its actions count; the routing layer samples counterparties weighted by a decaying signal of past cooperation. Cloned identities start with a cold nebula of zero receipts, so each clone must pay real compute and delay to earn receipts, while sharing a receipt graph across clones collapses their independence weight to near zero. Marginal clone cost: duplicated work plus forfeited routing priority, strictly negative-EV.
